components.text:
Circle: medium circle, infernal chalk.

Curses the owner of the taglock: they take 25% more damage, 50% at strength 1, 75% at strength 2, and never more than double.

Anyone can cast it, with a bottle of vampire blood. A blow that cannot be survived anyway (the void, a command) is not raised.

The curse ends when the target dies. It needs infernal chalk, not ritual chalk.
